Kunal Chauhan | kunal.chauhan384@example.com | +91 9149731733
Remote (India)

Professional Summary
Performance-driven digital marketing leader with a strong background in SEM, SEO and Social Media Marketing. Proven track record of driving acquisition and reducing cost-per-action through data-driven campaigns and iterative testing. Comfortable working in Agile environments and using Jira to manage cross-functional initiatives. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Social Media Marketing, SEM, Agile, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Digital Marketing Manager, Swiggy (Oct 2023 - Mar 2026)
- Led multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns emphasizing Google Ads and SEM to increase new user sign-ups by 28% while lowering CPA by 17% through bid strategy optimization and audience segmentation.
- Designed and executed Social Media Marketing initiatives that boosted engagement rate by 45% and contributed to a 12% lift in monthly active users via creative testing and calendar-driven promotions.
- Partnered with product and analytics teams in an Agile process (using Jira) to launch targeted promotional flows, improving first-order conversion by 9%.

Performance Marketer, Orbit Health (Jun 2022 - Sep 2023)
- Ran SEM campaigns focused on lead generation for telehealth services, improving lead quality score by 22% and reducing cost-per-lead by 30% through keyword refinement and landing page A/B tests.
- Implemented on-site SEO improvements and technical fixes that increased organic search traffic by 35% over six months, coordinating sprints and tasks in Jira.
- Managed Google Ads accounts with granular audience retargeting, contributing to a 18% uplift in appointment bookings from paid channels.

Digital Marketing Manager, Finlytics (Mar 2018 - May 2022)
- Owned SEM and Google Ads strategy for financial SaaS products, scaling paid acquisition while reducing average CPA by 24% via campaign restructuring and negative keyword strategies.
- Executed SEO roadmap including content optimization and backlink initiatives that grew organic sign-ups by 3x over two years.
- Collaborated with engineering and product teams in Agile cycles, tracking tasks in Jira to launch onboarding funnels and performance optimizations.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
